item.title: Oil prices drop and stock markets rise after reports of deal to end Iran war
item.description: Reports have raised hopes of an agreement between the US and Iran after days of escalation.

item.title: China calls for Strait to be reopened 'as soon as possible' in Iran talks
item.description: Wang Yi is holding talks with Iran's foreign minister Aragchi who is on his first trip to China since the war began.

item.title: Russia ignores Ukraine's unilateral ceasefire and attacks kindergarten
item.description: Ukraine's president says Russia has "spurned the ceasefire" and Kyiv is deciding on further action to take.

item.title: BBC traces how 10 minutes of Israeli bombing brought devastation to Lebanon
item.description: The bombs started falling at 14:15 in the afternoon - bringing chaos and destruction across the country.

item.title: Russian attacks kill more than 20 ahead of rival ceasefires proposed by Kyiv and Moscow
item.description: Kyiv said it would begin a truce on 6 May and then "act symmetrically" after Moscow declared a pause for its Victory Day parade.

item.title: Iran considering US proposal as Trump says war will be 'over quickly'
item.description: Mediator Pakistan says it is "endeavouring to convert this ceasefire into a permanent end to this war".
